response: ["The condition group routed to is melanoma (MEL).","Guidelines exist for the management of melanoma.","For the initial_local_management question type, recommendations are available.","Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness.","Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is also recommended for melanoma in situ.","Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.","Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor.","Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting whenever possible.","When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.","Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia.","The consensus rate for the recommendation is 100 % (21/21)."]
